blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 SINGAPORE—Out for nearly a year in the pro boxing scene, Eumir Marcial announced his return with a bang on Sunday. His third consecutive Asian Games appearance, however, isn’t pushing through. The Filipino middleweight prospect delivered a spectacular third-round knockout over fellow power puncher Omar Ulises Huerta at Pechanga Arena in San Diego, California, USA. READ: Eumir Marcial’s Asian Games status made uncertain by pro bout The quick end came when Marcial unleashed a devastating counter right hook that landed on Huerta’s temple, knocking the Mexican-American down for the count.
